bull_bear.body: The company plans to allocate capital towards investing in emerging technologies, making strategic acquisitions, and expanding its presence in international markets.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: The company faces risks related to intense competition, regulatory changes, and macroeconomic headwinds.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: The company's full-stack geospatial AI platform is a unique differentiator, and its focus on digital transformation and artificial intelligence positions it well for long-term growth.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Balance sheet is in net cash: Net Debt to Equity is shown as (0.10) for FY24, (0.30) for FY25 and (0.36) for FY26.
- Net Worth has scaled from INR 2,341 Mn (FY24) to INR 4,119 Mn (FY25) to INR 6,730 Mn (FY26).
- Reinvestment is directed to inorganic and platform bets - up to INR 250 Mn into the AI Fabrik JV, the completed VTS acquisition in the USA, and further planned acquisitions across Geospatial, Mobility and Tech; no dividend policy or payout is mentioned in the deck.
- Returns are shown on a combined "ROCE & ROE (%)" chart with FY24 / FY25 / FY26 values of 15.0% / 15.3% / 19.8% and 16.3% / 16.6% / 19.5% (the deck's legend does not bind which series is ROE and which is ROCE).

business.body: Geospatial and Engineering Services: INR 3,588 Mn (FY26); Technology Solutions: INR 3,009 Mn (FY26)
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
- "Unlike any other player, we operate at the intersection of" core engineering, geospatial intelligence, artificial intelligence and infrastructure and mobility systems - delivering "a full-stack geospatial AI platform powering intelligent infrastructure".
- Framed as "Consistent Results in an Inconsistent Market": while most players struggle with slow procurement cycles, funding winter and delayed decision-making, the company claims a healthy pipeline across Government, PSU and Infra Enterprises and early international traction in MEA despite macro headwinds.
- "CS TECH Ai has delivered continuous 3 years of positive revenue growth" and has "100+ projects being executed with zero client churn" - summarised as "Repeatable, Predictable, Proven."
- Problem framing: infrastructure planning is "outdated, slow, and fragmented", GIS systems are "passive and underutilized", data sources (satellites, drones, IoT) are under-leveraged and manual decision-making drives cost, inefficiency and risk; the company's answer is AI plus geospatial intelligence "to drive smarter and faster decisions at scale".
- Delivery model is stated as "We don't just build tech - we engineer outcomes", built on real-time data integration from drones/satellites/sensors, AI-driven digital twins of assets, cities and utilities, visual dashboards for smart decisioning, and actionable insights for planning, maintenance and operations.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Receivables / Government dues] "Recently Maharashtra Government has issued GR to allocate substantial funds for the payment of dues of IOT and other projects. This is expected to substantially improve the working capital cycle in next 2-3 quarters."
- [International momentum] "The international business of Geospatial and Mobility have shown substantial improvement and new business development opportunities and award of contracts have improved in this reporting quarter."
- [Shareholding, as on 30 June 2026] Promoter 50.9%, FII 10.1%, DII 0.2%, Public 38.8%; 29,703 shareholders other than promoter.
- [Capital market data, as on 30 June 2026] CMP INR 905.6, 52-week high/low 1,952.0 / 796.8, market cap INR 18,961.1 Mn, shares outstanding 20.9 Mn, face value INR 10.0, average volume 147.8 ('000).
- [Structural demand thesis] "The World is Urbanizing, Ageing, and Digitizing. Infrastructure must keep up" - today's decisions about cities, utilities and transport are said to demand real-time, intelligent and predictive support.
business.title: Notable from the deck

outlook.body: The company plans to leverage government initiatives, expand its empanelment, and build technical and strategic partnerships to drive growth. It also plans to invest in emerging technologies and make strategic acquisitions to fuel future growth.
outlook.title: Guidance / outlook

outlook.body: The company has a strong pipeline of projects and plans to expand its presence in international markets, particularly in the MEA region.
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Ceinsys Tech Limited is a geospatial technology company that provides innovative solutions for infrastructure development, with a strong focus on artificial intelligence and digital transformation. The company has delivered consistent revenue growth and has a healthy pipeline of projects across government, PSU, and infra enterprises. With its full-stack geospatial AI platform, Ceinsys Tech Limited is well-positioned to capitalize on the growing demand for intelligent infrastructure solutions.
